settings.name: resend_from
settings.description: The address to send as through Resend, instead of the site's Email from setting, as name@yourdomain.com or Shop Name <name@yourdomain.com>. Leave empty to use Email from. For testing, Resend lets any account send as onboarding@resend.dev, but only to the address you signed up to Resend with

settings.name: resend_api_key
settings.description: Your Resend API key, from resend.com/api-keys. Stored encrypted and never shown again. The address emails are sent from must be on a domain you have verified with Resend
